question:
In the given triangle KMN, PQ is parallel to MN. If (KP)/(PM) = (4)/(13) and KN = 20.4 cm, find KQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c9562a5f5030fdeffd254e63ac630012b44b2795285144db525e478ef01a157.png]
solution:
**Given:**

(KP)/(PM) = (4)/(13) and KN = 20.4 cm

**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c9562a5f5030fdeffd254e63ac630012b44b2795285144db525e478ef01a157.png] 

In a triangle ΔKMN, when PQ is parallel to MN then (KP)/(PM) = (KQ)/(QN) 

**Calculation:**

Now, (KP)/(PM) = (4)/(13) and (KP)/(PM) = (KQ)/(QN) 

⇒ (KQ)/(QN) = (4)/(13)

Let KQ = 4x and QN = 13x 

Given KN = 20.4 cm and KN = KQ + QN

⇒ KQ + QN = 4x + 13x = 20.4 cm

⇒ 17x = 20.4

 ⇒ x = 1.2

∴ KQ = 4x = 4 × 1.2 = 4.8 cm
